theorems.name: Submission.fiw_im_mass_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
